paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the performance changes of two metrics, Recall@50 and NDCG@50, with respect to the depth of search, comparing two methods: "Ours" and ReFICR. The x-axis represents the depth of search, labeled as an integer value ranging from 1 to 5 with equal intervals. The y-axis on the left side is labeled Recall@50, and the y-axis on the right side is labeled NDCG@50. The green solid line representing Recall@50 (Ours) starts at approximately 0.35 and increases to around 0.49. The green dotted line representing Recall@50 (ReFICR) remains steady at 0.48 across the x-axis. The blue solid line representing NDCG@50 (Ours) starts at approximately 0.33 and increases to around 0.47. The blue dotted line representing NDCG@50 (ReFICR) remains steady at 0.32 across the x-axis.
